what: كم كلمة في البطاقة وكم تبقى، وكيف يكون الخروج أقصر من الدخول. / How much text per card, how long it holds, and why exits are shorter than entrances.

what: لكل عاطفة صوت طباعي: أوامر بخط مكثف أسود، سرد بخط عريض، نظام بخط أحادي، همس بسيريف مائل. / One typographic voice per emotion: condensed black for commands, wide sans for narration, mono for system, italic serif for whispers.
how: Max 3–4 voices, one per card, switched on the beat. Four voices: condensed black caps (commands), wide geometric sans 800 lowercase (narration), mono (system/UI), italic serif (intimate asides) (pm-kloss-xyz-15182a). Three voices: ultra-black condensed scream, wide extended ExtraBold secondary, mono crumbs; tracking −40…−80 for display, +20 for mono (pm-techhalla-7acbc2: #c5fc34 / #ff2bd6 on #0a0a0a). Editorial: condensed serif for headlines and quotes (italic for emphasis), monospace only for user-typed text, tracked small-caps sans labels at 1.2 % H, 0.12em, coloured dot bullets, 3 families max (pm-henkvaness-0e06af). Whisper vs shout: light italic serif ~5 % H for soft lines, black soft serif lowercase 20–25 % H for climactic words, per lyric emotion (pm-samaote-5e2fc2). Light serif narration vs heavy caps keyword at 1 : 5 (pm-gdgtify-287ddf); marker-script display + giant numerals ~2.5× with tracked mono metadata at ~1/6 size, 0.15em (pm-sarut0bisasuke-cefa43). Mixed-typeface sentence — every word a different family/size/position, hero word 25 % H, ~200 ms stagger, one word retyped (pm-fionntobin-97b7af) — a deliberate one-sentence exception to the two-family rule.
params: 3–4 voices; one per card; display −40…−80 / mono +20 tracking

what: اختر خط الترجمة وحركتها من نبرة النص، وبدّلها مع عالم كل مقطع. / Pick caption face and motion from the transcript's tone, and swap them per segment's world.
how: Tone map: hype = heavy condensed 800–900, scale-pop back.out(1.7) 0.1–0.2 s, 72–96 px; corporate = clean sans 600–700, fade + slide power3.out 0.3 s, 56–72 px; tutorial = mono/sans 500–600 typewriter 0.4–0.5 s, 48–64 px; storytelling = serif 400–500 slow fade power2. Per-word emphasis on brand names, numbers, CAPS, emotional words, CTA. Theme map per segment: italic serif for lo-fi, bubble 3D for viral, slab serif sepia for cartoon, comic balloon for manga, engraved gold serif for a card (pm-sab8a-364a5a). Diary system: amber #F2B84B with a 50 % #1A1A1A shadow, title 8 % / subtitle 5 % of frame height for 3–4 s, bottom comment 5 % ≤18 chars/line, a top-left list adding one line per spoken item at 8 % margin. Word-timing mechanics live in SYNC.
params: hype 72–96 px / 0.1–0.2 s; corporate 56–72 / 0.3 s; tutorial 48–64 / 0.4–0.5 s; diary #F2B84B

how: Festival lineup: headliner in wide 900 caps, then rows at 100 % → 45 % → 30 % → 22 % → 18 % joined by middle dots; rows stagger 100 ms with fade + translateY 12 px; line-height 1.25; max width 90 % (pm-gonzalomacagno-2de1a9: #1c1838 on #c4a4ed / #f3daed). Type-scale staircase: a row of ‘Aa’ samples at a ~1.2× geometric ratio, 10–11 steps, baseline-aligned, popping in L → R with 60–80 ms stagger, mono token + ratio labels in red/grey beneath (pm-ddryo-loos-300829).

name_en: Catalog kinetic styles: brutalist · minimal · typewriter
what: ثلاثة استايلات طباعية أصلية في KOSIF لها وصفات مكتوبة وأمر scaffold يعمل هنا. / Three original KOSIF type styles with written recipes and a scaffold command that runs here.

Brutalist: hero 120–220 px weight 900, hard cuts on beats, few colours, no easing softness. Minimal: 24 px grid, ≥30 % empty frame, two sizes, entrances 300–450 ms ease-out. Typewriter: 25–45 cps ±20 % seeded jitter, 250–400 ms pause after punctuation, caret 530 ms; Arabic by word or mask. The motion itself is written from each SKILL.md — no prebuilt animation ships.
params: brutalist 120–220 px/900; minimal 24 px grid ≥30 % empty; typewriter 25–45 cps

name_en: Type that keeps moving through cuts
what: طبقات النص التوكيدي لها حركة مستمرة خاصة (انجراف، تأرجح، تباعد حروف) مستقلة عن شبكة اللقطات، فتحمل العين عبر القطع. — Emphasis type layers carry their own continuous motion (drift, sway, tracking) independent of the shot grid, so they carry the eye across cuts.
when: مونتاج متحدث مع نصوص تأكيد ولقطات مساندة — a talking-head edit with emphasis type and B-roll.
how: Enter styles: soft, blur, rise, cut, type, wipe, slam, pop, blurpop, draw, flicker; exits cut (default), blur, fade 0.12 s, drift 0.28 s. Reveal per word on the spoken word; *word* → italic serif accent. Use a readability halo instead of a hard drop shadow, and do not put dark plates under text: darken the background exposure and add a soft shadow (0 8px 48px rgba(0,0,0,.45)).
params: fade 0.12 s; drift exit 0.28 s; shadow 0 8 48 px α .45
